table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode,
	Regno = (SELECT Patient.RegNo FROM Patient WHERE Patient.PatientCode = (SELECT PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission WHERE AdmissionCode = :ai_Code)),
	PatientAdmission.PatientCode,   
	PatientAdmission.CustCode, 
	PatientAdmission.LocationCode,   
	PatientLocation.WardCode,
	PatientAdmission.Date,   
	PatientAdmission.DoctorCode,   
	PatientAdmission.UserCode,
	PatientAdmission.DiseaseCode,
	PatientAdmission.Diagnosis,
	PatientAdmission.Remarks,
	PatientAdmission.RecurringServicesChargedOn,
	PatientAdmission.ServiceInvCode,
	PatientAdmission.Discharged1,
	PatientAdmission.Discharged,
	PatientAdmission.CashAccCode,
	PatientAdmission.CashTendered,
	PatientAdmission.CashCharged,
	PatientAdmission.CashBack,
	PatientAdmission.NextOfKins,
	PatientAdmission.RelationCode,
	PatientAdmission.NextOfKinsContactNo,
	PatientAdmission.Ref1,
	PatientAdmission.Ref2,
	PatientAdmission.Ref3,
	PatientAdmission.Ref4,
	PatientAdmission.ProcedureRequired,
	PatientAdmission.ProcedureCharges,
	PatientAdmission.ProcedureGSTPerc,
	PatientAdmission.TransportCharges,
	PatientAdmission.	DischargeReasonCode
FROM 
	PatientAdmission,
	PatientLocation
WHERE 
	PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode = :ai_Code AND
	PatientAdmission.LocationCode = PatientLocation.LocationCode
